# If you add religions, and use those tags, do not change them without changing everywhere they are used.

# Uses all 'modifiers' possible thats exported as a Modifier.

christian = {
	defender_of_faith = yes
	can_form_personal_unions = yes
	
	center_of_religion = 118 # Rome

	# Flag emblem values - Used for Dynamic Setup of Random Nations.
	# Emblem texture: game/gfx/interface/client_state_symbols_large.dds
	# Can be overridden per religion.
	flags_with_emblem_percentage = 33 # default == 0
	flag_emblem_index_range = { 1 57 }

	# BEGIN RITES (generated by tools/rites.py - edit the table there)
	religious_schools = {
		roman_rite_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = can_always_invite_roman_rite_school
					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_roman_rite_school
				}
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that follows that school
			can_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = can_always_invite_roman_rite_school }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_roman_rite_school }
					}
					reverse_has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 150 }
					OR = {
						alliance_with = FROM
						is_subject_of = FROM
						overlord_of = FROM
					}
					hidden_progressive_opinion_for_scholar_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = roman_rite_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = roman_rite_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}
			}

			invite_scholar_modifier_display = roman_rite_scholar_modifier

			picture = "GFX_icon_rite_roman_rite"

			diplomatic_reputation = 1
		}
		carolingian_rite_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes

					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_carolingian_rite_school

						ai = yes

					}

								RELIGION = protestant
							}
						}
						change_religion = protestant
						add_reform_center = protestant
					}
				}

			}

				name = "conversion_zeal"
				duration = 3650
			}

				}

				can_have_center_of_reformation_trigger = {
					RELIGION = reformed
				}
			}
		}
		
		on_convert = {
			change_religion = reformed
			add_prestige = -100
			remove_country_modifier = counter_reformation
			remove_country_modifier = the_statue_in_restraint_of_appeals
			remove_country_modifier = revocation_of_restraint_of_appeals
			remove_country_modifier = bavarian_jesuits
			remove_country_modifier = the_societas_jesu
			remove_country_modifier = the_declaration_of_indulgence
			remove_country_modifier = de_heretico_comburendo
			remove_country_modifier = the_conventicle_act
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = reformation_money
					NOT = {
						calc_true_if = {
							all_province = {
								religion = reformed
								is_reformation_center = yes
							}
							amount = 3
						}
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					random_owned_province = {
						limit = {
							can_have_center_of_reformation_trigger = {
								RELIGION = reformed
							}
						}
						change_religion = reformed
						add_reform_center = reformed
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = CENTER_OF_REFORMATION_POSSIBLE
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = reformation_money }
					NOT = {
						calc_true_if = {
							all_province = {
								religion = reformed
								is_reformation_center = yes
							}
							amount = 3
						}
					}
				}
				add_years_of_income = 1.0
				hidden_effect = {
					random_owned_province = {
						limit = {
							can_have_center_of_reformation_trigger = {
								RELIGION = reformed
							}
						}
						change_religion = reformed
						add_reform_center = reformed
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = CENTER_OF_REFORMATION_POSSIBLE
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				name = "conversion_zeal"
				duration = 3650
			}
			set_country_flag = "reformation_money"
			every_known_country = {
				limit = {
					reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = opinion_demote_pope
					}
				}
				reverse_remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = opinion_demote_pope
				}
			}
		}
		
		heretic = { METHODIST BAPTIST QUAKER }
		
		date = 1536.5.1
		
		fervor = yes
	}

		hanafi_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = can_always_invite_hanafi_school
					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_hanafi_school
				}
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that follows that school
			can_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = can_always_invite_hanafi_school }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_hanafi_school }
					}
					reverse_has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 150 }
					OR = {
						alliance_with = FROM
						is_subject_of = FROM
						overlord_of = FROM
					}
					hidden_progressive_opinion_for_scholar_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = hanafi_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT

				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}

					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = alawite_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = alawite_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}
			}

			invite_scholar_modifier_display = alawite_scholar_modifier

			picture = "GFX_icon_rite_alawite"

			defensiveness = 0.1
		}

			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = can_always_invite_vinaya_school
					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_vinaya_school
				}
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that follows that school
			can_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = can_always_invite_vinaya_school }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_vinaya_school }
					}
					reverse_has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 150 }
					OR = {
						alliance_with = FROM
						is_subject_of = FROM
						overlord_of = FROM
					}
					hidden_progressive_opinion_for_scholar_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = vinaya_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = vinaya_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}

pagan = {

	flags_with_emblem_percentage = 10
	flag_emblem_index_range = { 83 96 }

	# BEGIN RITES (generated by tools/rites.py - edit the table there)
	religious_schools = {
		slavic_pagan_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = can_always_invite_slavic_pagan_school
					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_slavic_pagan_school
				}
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that follows that school
			can_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = can_always_invite_slavic_pagan_school }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_slavic_pagan_school }
					}
					reverse_has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 150 }
					OR = {
						alliance_with = FROM
						is_subject_of = FROM
						overlord_of = FROM
					}
					hidden_progressive_opinion_for_scholar_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = slavic_pagan_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = slavic_pagan_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}
			}

			invite_scholar_modifier_display = slavic_pagan_scholar_modifier

			picture = "GFX_icon_rite_slavic_pagan"

			global_manpower_modifier = 0.05
		}

					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = bilikuism_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = bilikuism_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}
			}

jewish_group = {
	flags_with_emblem_percentage = 33
	flag_emblem_index_range = { 106 107 }

	# BEGIN RITES (generated by tools/rites.py - edit the table there)
	religious_schools = {
		haymanot_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = can_always_invite_haymanot_school
					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_haymanot_school
				}
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that follows that school
			can_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = can_always_invite_haymanot_school }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_haymanot_school }
					}
					reverse_has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 150 }
					OR = {
						alliance_with = FROM
						is_subject_of = FROM
						overlord_of = FROM
					}
					hidden_progressive_opinion_for_scholar_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = haymanot_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = haymanot_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}
			}

			invite_scholar_modifier_display = haymanot_scholar_modifier

			picture = "GFX_icon_rite_haymanot"

			defensiveness = 0.1
		}
		kabarism_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes

				add_country_modifier = { name = merkabah_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }

	jewish = {
		icon = 20
		color = { 26 179 255 }
		country = {
			tolerance_own = 2
			advisor_pool = 1
		}
		country_as_secondary = {
			advisor_pool = 1
			advisor_cost = -0.1
		}
		province = {
			local_missionary_strength = -0.02
		}
		
		uses_judaism_power = yes
		aspects_name = JEWISH_ASPECTS
			
		aspects = {
			judaism_rosh_hashanah_aspect
			judaism_simchat_torah_aspect
			judaism_sukkot_aspect
			judaism_communities_aspect
			jewish_abrahamic_aspect
			judaism_diplomatic_rabbi_aspect
			judaism_yom_kippur_aspect
			judaism_remember_passover_aspect
			judaism_purim_teachings_aspect
		}
		
		heretic = { SAMARITAN KARAITE }

		celebrate = {
			cost = 200
			potential = {
			}
			allow = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = JUDAISM_HAS_ADM_ASPECT
					OR = {
						has_church_aspect = judaism_rosh_hashanah_aspect
						has_church_aspect = judaism_simchat_torah_aspect
						has_church_aspect = judaism_sukkot_aspect
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_church_aspect = judaism_rosh_hashanah_aspect
					}
					NOT = { stability = 3 }
				}
			}
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_church_aspect = judaism_rosh_hashanah_aspect
					}
					add_stability = 1
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_church_aspect = judaism_simchat_torah_aspect
					}
					change_government_reform_progress = 25
					add_legitimacy_equivalent = {
						amount = 5
						republican_tradition = 5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_heir = yes
						}
						add_heir_claim = 5
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_church_aspect = judaism_sukkot_aspect
					}
					add_years_of_income = 0.3
					add_inflation = -1
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_government_attribute = loyalty_from_celebration
					}
					add_estate_loyalty = {
						estate = estate_church
						loyalty = 20
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = has_celebrated_festival } }
						set_country_flag = has_celebrated_festival
					}
				}
			}
			ai_will_do = {
				factor = 1
				modifier = {
					factor = 0
					OR = {
						AND = {
							NOT = { has_church_aspect = judaism_communities_aspect }
							NOT = { has_church_aspect = jewish_abrahamic_aspect }
							NOT = { has_church_aspect = judaism_diplomatic_rabbi_aspect }
						}
						AND = {
							NOT = { has_church_aspect = judaism_yom_kippur_aspect }
							NOT = { has_church_aspect = judaism_remember_passover_aspect }
							NOT = { has_church_aspect = judaism_purim_teachings_aspect }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		afridunism_school = {
			potential_invite_scholar = {
				OR = {
					knows_of_scholar_country_capital_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = can_always_invite_afridunism_school
					has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_afridunism_school
				}
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that follows that school
			can_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = can_always_invite_afridunism_school }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = privilege_can_always_invite_afridunism_school }
					}
					reverse_has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 150 }
					OR = {
						alliance_with = FROM
						is_subject_of = FROM
						overlord_of = FROM
					}
					hidden_progressive_opinion_for_scholar_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = afridunism_scholar_modifier }
			}

			# THIS = Nation wanting to invite the scholar, FROM = Nation that sends the scholar
			on_invite_scholar = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = no_scholar_adm_cost }
					}
					adm_power_cost = 50
				}
				clear_rite_scholar_modifiers_effect = yes
				custom_tooltip = INVITE_CLERIC_COUNTRY_TEXT
				add_country_modifier = { name = afridunism_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						ai = yes
					}
					add_country_modifier = { name = has_invited_scholar_recently duration = 7300 hidden = yes }
				}
			}

			invite_scholar_modifier_display = afridunism_scholar_modifier

			picture = "GFX_icon_rite_afridunism"

			defensiveness = 0.05
		}
